features:
FRUITFUL O'S CEREAL: Enjoy the combination of delicious fruity taste for kids, plus parent-approved goodness; A fruit flavored cereal your whole family can enjoy

GLUTEN FREE KIDS CEREAL: This gluten free cereal has no artificial flavors or colors from artificial sources; Pair with your choice of milk or enjoy by the handful as a crispy kids snack

ORGANIC AND NON GMO: Certified USDA Organic and made with Non-GMO Project Verified ingredients for the wholesomeness you'd expect from Cascadian Farm Organic Cereals

MADE WITH WHOLE GRAIN: 16g of whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily)

CONTAINS: One 10.2 oz cereal box of Cascadian Farm Fruitful O's Fruit Flavored Cereal
ingredients: Whole Grain Yellow Corn Meal*, Cane Sugar*, Yellow Corn Meal*, Whole Grain Purple Corn Flour*, Tapioca Syrup*, Sunflower Oil*, Sea Salt, Calcium Carbonate, Annatto*, Natural Flavor*. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. *Organic
